description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certification of Exemption - 1. Overseas Realty (Ceylon) Plc. 2. Square Eighth Engineering 2. Property Finance and Investment Kandy (Private) Limited
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It grants certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply to specific entities, which constitutes a regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel changes.
